title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who violates section 264-101 is guilty of a petty misdemeanor and shall be fined not more than $1,000 or imprisoned not more than thirty days, or both.
bodyHtml: §264-102  Penalty.  Any person who violates section 264-101 is guilty of a petty misdemeanor and shall be fined not more than $1,000 or imprisoned not more than thirty days, or both. [L 1980, c 44, pt of §1; am L 2000, c 23, §2]
